title: Chronological arcade run from first dodge to Double Wall explosion

clips.why: Quickly teaches catching stars and avoiding comets without slow tutorial text
Builds momentum with star combos and comet weaving
First major obstacle: Comet Wall gap thread with CLOSE! +5 bonus
Escalates difficulty with Zig-Zag comets and COMBO x8
Introduces Split Rocks and a last-second Shield power-up save
Culminates in the Double Wall gauntlet and dramatic explosion
Comet Dodge end card with PLAY NOW button
